notes.title: New Levels - Version 0.2 Out Now with Gravity
notes.notes:
Version 0.2 patch is now available.

[b]Changes include:[/b]
[list]
[*] 18 new levels to bring the total to 60.
[*] Added black holes, X-cube prisms and intermediate targets.
[*] Graphics quality option in the setting menu.
[*] 2 additional achievements for level progression.
[*] Fixed a minor refraction bug in level 8.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.3 Patch Out Now - Graphics Update
notes.notes:
The 0.1.3 patch is now available.

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated laser graphics, lighting effects and glass refractor graphics.
[*] Added windowed mode support. Available in the settings menu. 
[*] Performance improvements to reduce CPU usage.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.2 Patch Out Now - Hints Added
notes.notes:
The 0.1.2 patch is now available. Includes hints and a minor change to the large reflectors.

[b]Solution Hints:[/b]
[list]
[*] An in-game hint system has been added. Clicking on the light bulb icon will reveal a small part of a possible solution to provide some guidance to completing the level. Hints have been added to all levels except the first two.
[/list]
[b]Large Reflectors:[/b]
[list]
[*] The larger rectangle reflectors/mirrors have been changed from 4 sided reflection to 2 sided reflection. They no longer reflect on the short edges. 
[/list]

notes.title: 0.1.1 Patch Out Now
notes.notes:
The 0.1.1 patch is now available. Includes faster methods for moving and rotating. And a minor change to level 26.

[b]Movement of objects:[/b]
[list]
[*] No need to select an object first to display movement controls. A single control button is now displayed around the object as your cursor approaches.
[*] To move, click and drag the new button. Hold Left Shift to rotate. You can swap from move to rotate seamlessly.
[*] Previous move and rotate buttons are still available and function as before. 
[*] The "X" button has been removed. Drag and drop to the edges to return an object to the toolbar.
[*] Level 1 tutorial has been updated with the revised controls.
[*] Left Shift can be customised in the settings.
[/list]
[b]Level 26:[/b]
[list]
[*] A missing block was added back to level 26. Designed to help guide the player to the intended solution.
[/list]
The next update will focus on adding help tips.
